title: Delete Columns to Make Sorted III
description: Find the minimum number of columns to delete to make the remaining columns lexicographically non-decreasing.
pseudocode:
1. dp = new Array(cols).fill(1)
2. for j = 1 to cols - 1:
3.   for i = 0 to j - 1:
4.     if all rows[r][i] <= rows[r][j]:
5.       dp[j] = max(dp[j], dp[i] + 1)
6. return cols - max(dp)

steps.note: Initialize DP array where dp[j] is the length of the longest sorted sequence ending at column j.
Compare column 0 and column 1. They are sorted, so we update dp[1].
Compare column 0 and column 2. Not sorted, dp[2] remains 1.
Compare column 1 and column 2. Not sorted, dp[2] remains 1.
Result is total columns (3) minus max(dp) (2), which is 1.
